name: guildloom
description: guildloom - a game-flavored issue board for small teams

scripts.build: npm run build -w @guildloom/shared && npm run build -w @guildloom/server && npm run build -w @guildloom/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @guildloom/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @guildloom/server" "npm run dev -w @guildloom/web"
